title: Search When Needed, Proceed When Reliable: Metacognitive Reliability Supervision for Efficient Agentic Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.41738v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Efficient agentic search requires large language models (LLMs) to determine whether they can reliably proceed with their current knowledge or need additional external evidence. Supervision based on final-answer correctness or trajectory-level feedback evaluates realized trajectory performance. However, observed trajectory performance is jointly shaped by stochastic generation, retrieval quality, and downstream reasoning. Such signals therefore provide only indirect evidence of how reliable the current decision state was and how retrieved evidence changed its reliability. An effective reward should encourage search when external information is needed and favor searches that contribute to the answer. To this end, we propose a metacognitive framework for training LLMs to make search decisions based on the reliability of their intermediate reasoning states. translated_title: 需要时搜索，可靠时推进：面向高效智能体搜索的元认知可靠性监督
translated_abstract: 高效的智能体搜索要求大语言模型（LLM）能够判断自己是可以基于当前知识可靠地继续推进，还是需要额外的外部证据。基于最终答案正确性或轨迹级反馈的监督方法评估的是已实现的轨迹表现。然而，观测到的轨迹表现是由随机生成、检索质量和下游推理共同塑造的，因此这类信号只能为当前决策状态的可靠性以及检索证据如何改变其可靠性提供间接证据。一个有效的奖励应当在需要外部信息时鼓励搜索，并偏好那些对答案有贡献的搜索。为此，我们提出了一个元认知框架，用于训练LLM基于其中间推理状态的可靠性来做出搜索决策。该框架通过估计局部结论的可靠性来区分是否需要……
tldr: 该论文提出元认知可靠性监督框架，通过评估LLM中间推理状态的可靠性来训练模型在需要时搜索、可靠时推进，从而实现更高效的智能体搜索。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a metacognitive reliability supervision framework that trains LLMs to make efficient agentic search decisions by estimating the reliability of their intermediate reasoning states—searching only when needed and proceeding when reliable.
